name: Sifa Smyth
source:
Sifa grew up with the weight of high expectations to be a smart, accomplished student—and she has lived up to every one. As would be the case for anyone, such pressure takes its toll. She'd like to explore things that make her happy, instead of what makes others happy.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
